_doc: Visitor points of interest: floating circle markers (photo or icon) with a connector line down to their ground position. Orientation aids, NOT qanat facts. Place a POI by `geo` (EPSG:4326) or anchor it to a shaft (`anchorShaft`, follows that shaft's rendered position). `icon` is drawn when no `photo` is given (or while/if it fails to load): parking | shaft | spring | info. `photo` is a path under assets/poi/ with its `photoCredit`.

pois.name: Raschpëtzer Parking
pois.description: Forest car park on the Pëtschend plateau, next to the 'Départ Auto pédestre Walferdange' trailhead — the nearest public surface parking to the shaft line (~400 m SE of P9).
pois.note: Position is the OSM amenity=parking area (way 385690665). Which of the nearby plateau car parks the 'Raschpëtzer' parking signs point to is inferred, not confirmed — verify on site.

pois.name: P5 — visitor shaft
pois.description: Deepest shaft (≈36 m) on the eastern plateau edge; first cleared to its base on 3 Oct 1986, rediscovering the gallery. A windowed metal cover lets visitors look down the shaft.
pois.note: Click the shaft itself for its documented depth, floor level and provenance.

pois.name: Qanat spring outflow
pois.photoCredit: GilPe, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons — “Walferdange, Grünewald, Raschpëtzer (104).jpg”
pois.description: Visible water outflow at the end of the secondary channel, reconstructed in 2000 to show how the Roman channel is built inside the hill: dry-stone side walls covered with flat stones and gravel.
pois.note: Position is the photo's Commons geotag (camera location, ± a few metres). The field-surveyed overflow resurgence lies ~70 m east (see the P-4 overflow channel).
